backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (UserProfile, Video, Comment, CarMeet, DirectMessage, Notification, BuildStage, etc.) and including authorization and blob-storage mixins for the RevReel car community platform.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that feed cache invalidation/refetch after a successful video upload is implemented in `frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts`.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of every frontend source file, describing fixes and responsibilities for hooks, pages, and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the UI.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a `#root` div and loads `src/main.tsx` as an ES module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router tree with all application routes (feed, profile, upload, discover, inbox, meets, builds, classifieds, admin, etc.) wrapped in a shared layout route and a React Query client provider.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Wrapper component that renders a neon-styled login prompt when the user is unauthenticated and shows children when authenticated, with a loading spinner during initialization.
frontend/src/components/CarMeetCard.tsx: Card component for a car meet listing that displays location, date, and attendee count, and provides attend/leave toggle buttons for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/ChallengeModal.t: A modal dialog that lets the current user select one of their videos to send a challenge to another user, using the postChallenge mutation and displaying loading/error states.
frontend/src/components/CommentsPanel.ts: A slide-in panel that displays sorted comments for a given video and allows authenticated users to post new comments, with relative timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: A modal form for editing the current user's profile, supporting username, bio, and avatar image upload with preview, backed by the updateProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/FollowButton.tsx: A toggle button that follows or unfollows a user based on the current follower list, hidden when viewing one's own profile or when unauthenticated.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The root application layout providing a fixed top header with navigation links, upload button, profile link, logout, and a bottom nav bar, plus a ProfileSetupModal trigger for new users.
frontend/src/components/PostIssueModal.t: A modal form for posting a car mechanics issue with title, category, and description fields, submitting via the createMechanicsPost mutation and showing toast notifications on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/PostListingModal: A modal dialog form for creating a new parts/car listing with fields for title, make, model, year, price, condition, category, image URL, and description, using the useCreateListing mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/PostMeetModal.ts: A modal dialog form for organizing a car meetup, collecting title, location, datetime, category, and description, then submitting via the useCreateCarMeet mutation with timestamp conversion to nanoseconds.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A mandatory (non-dismissible) modal for first-time users to set up their profile with a username, bio, and optional avatar upload, saving via the useSaveCallerUserProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/StartBuildLogMod: A modal dialog form for starting a new car build log with fields for title, make, model, year, and description, submitted via the useCreateBuildLog mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A full-screen video/photo card component supporting likes, emoji reactions, save/unsave, delete, view count tracking, comments panel, and challenge modal, with media rendered based on type (video or photo).
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using TanStack Query, invalidating and refetching all dependent queries whenever the actor (identity) changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines TanStack Query hooks for all backend interactions including user profiles, videos, comments, and reactions, re-exporting relevant backend types for consumers.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Barlow fonts, configuring Tailwind with OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, and defining utility classes for neon effects and glass-card styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: Static About page for RevReel displaying a hero section, platform description, feature list, and a CashApp donation button with clipboard copy functionality.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only page that lists all users and allows deletion, gating access behind an admin check and an AuthGuard component.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogDetails.tsx: Displays a single build log's details including car info, stages, and creation date. Allows the author to add new stages or delete the log, with loading/not-found states handled.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogs.tsx: Lists all build logs with car info and stage counts, and lets authenticated users create a new build log via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeetDetails.tsx: Shows details for a single car meet (location, date, category, attendees) and lets authenticated users join or leave the meet.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeets.tsx: Lists all car meets using CarMeetCard components and allows authenticated users to post a new meet via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/Classifieds.tsx: Displays active classified listings with image, price, and condition, and provides a link to post a new listing.
frontend/src/pages/Conversation.tsx: Renders a direct message conversation with a specific user, supporting sending, deleting, and auto-marking messages as read.
frontend/src/pages/Discover.tsx: Discover page that lets users search videos and browse trending categories and hashtags, navigating to a filtered feed on selection.
frontend/src/pages/Feed.tsx: Main feed page that displays all videos sorted by timestamp in a vertically snapping scroll layout, wrapped in an AuthGuard.
frontend/src/pages/FilteredFeed.tsx: Filtered feed page that shows videos filtered by either category or hashtag based on URL params, with a back-navigation header.
frontend/src/pages/Inbox.tsx: Inbox page listing all user conversations with the other user's avatar, last message preview, timestamp, and unread count badge.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing/marketing page with a hero section and Internet Identity login button; redirects authenticated users to the feed automatically.
frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx: Leaderboard page showing top trending videos and top racers ranked by total likes, with a decorative banner image.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetails.tsx: Detail page for a single classifieds listing showing its image, info, and seller profile, with a deactivate option for the listing owner.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicsHelp.tsx: Displays a list of community mechanics help posts with loading skeletons and an empty state, and provides a button to open a modal for posting a new issue.
Shows the full details of a single mechanics help post including comments, allows authenticated users to add comments, and lets the post author delete it.
frontend/src/pages/Notifications.tsx: Renders a list of user notifications with read/unread styling, supports marking individual or all notifications as read, and navigates to the sender's profile on click.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Displays a user's profile page with avatar, stats, badges, and tabbed sections for their uploaded videos and saved videos, with edit and follow functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Provides a form for uploading videos or photos with title, description, category, hashtags, and optional thumbnail, tracking upload progress and navigating to the feed on success.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routing, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom fonts (Barlow), oklch-based color tokens, neon shadows, border radii, and keyframe animations, while enabling dark mode and including typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the RevReel project's current state at version 3, recording an existing feed-refresh feature (REQ-1) and a pending fix request (AR-2/REQ-2) to ensure uploaded videos are correctly persisted and returned by the backend feed query.
